review_scope: Read-only external review2 candidate API/Record/field placement, original resolve_story/order_stop/callback semantics, five-record guard ordering and complete Core pairing. No implementation or native execution.

api_checks.detail: _queue is deferred and serialized in references, never values. Candidate now reads refs._queue in parts after original _references shape/order validation; _safe_retreat_values no longer reads v._queue.

All are native values fields. Original order_stop/clear_hua_lock writes CHASE_AUTO=0, group_cap=0.0, home=position, has_home=true and hua_lock_shots=0. Candidate checks only resolved lu/shi. It correctly leaves is_active/manual_order_active/garrisoned/path_i/process flags untouched.

api_checks.topic: single-safe required actors and event pairing
api_checks.detail: Original graph validates records and fixed role identities/membership. Candidate pairs lu and shi with their exact safe event iff story_outcome=retreated, rejects both safe, and for one safe requires both role references, records, positive hp/non-dying root+active membership and empty outcome for the non-safe actor. Zero-safe original route does not receive the new two-actor condition.

api_checks.topic: Root packet shapes and callback clearing
api_checks.detail: Root.validate returns value with selection Array of validated tags and references Dictionary. Candidate checks tag.state before accessing entity id and rejects safe IDs in selection/_ability_caster/_item_caster. Original callback erases selection and disarms matching casters. Groups/grids/cache rows remain unmodified.

api_checks.topic: cast arrays exact API and field mapping
api_checks.detail: Both constructors accept Codec,B,U; validate(record,version,known) returns arrays rather than value. Five arrays are _walk_casts(c), _pending_casts(caster), _channels(caster), _walk_item_casts(c), _pending_item_casts(caster). Their original validators first enforce exact fieldset and reference tags. cancel_pending_cast also cancels pending items; original story callback separately removes walk spell/item and channels. Candidate rejects only safe IDs as caster, preserves target and unrelated entries.

Before UnitGraph/Level/Presentation/Mission/Root validators, fixed sections must be Dictionaries and their explicit schema/version/level_id/mission_token leaves Strings. Mission/Presentation context is exactly four String leaves. Values still must satisfy original full validators; no casting, caller bool or saved path dispatch is added. Caller mission/presentation token type check precedes the typed helper invocation in prepare.

api_checks.topic: return shapes used by pair helper
api_checks.detail: UnitGraph.validate_index supplies known_ids and next_entity_id; UnitGraph.validate supplies value containing original records/root_order/active_order; CampaignLevel.validate supplies value.values/references/external; Presentation.validate supplies tokens; CampaignMission.validate supplies value.events(Array), actions(Dictionary), resume_eligible; Root.validate supplies value.values.phase. Identity.new(U).declare_entities(known) is a RefCounted abstract registry and validate/dispose does not allocate actual Unit/tombstones.

Capture runs pairing after all full sections/items are captured and before final world output; owned-identity failure follows previous ownership disposal convention. prepare runs original map validate first, then pairing and cast validators, then B.new and original Unit/World staging. No Node allocation/deploy/tick is introduced by the pair helper; original subsequent World/effect/binding/activation guards remain required.

limits.detail: This static review has no Godot parse/import or execution proof. Original full Session save/exit/independent-process restore/resave must test Lu-safe and Shi-safe actual natural cases, first HELD and later tick. Static schema consistency is not callback occurrence, natural result, reward, device/platform or public Continue qualification.

The added five-record guards cover their listed top-level identity/context leaves. They do not establish controlled rejection of every outer Core World/profile/Map leaf or deeper Codec/business payload. Those inherited validation paths remain separately tested obligations; no claim of zero SCRIPT ERROR for all DTO shapes is made.

Readonly Unit component membership remains complete_world=false. It cannot certify Mission events, Root/cast ownership or whole Session installation; complete Core and subsequent all-section guards remain necessary.

Required tests include per-field stop corruption, all five safe caster arrays, root selection/casters, safe event/outcome mismatch, missing/dead/nonactive other actor, both-safe FIGHT, terminal Mission, five-record identity primitive matrix and untouched source data/order. Native allocation-count zero and original-scene preservation must be observed, not inferred from this review.

recommendation: Review2 resolves the identified queue API error and pairing omissions without a newly identified static API blocker. Keep public source pinned until the active prior batch is terminal; implementation/native import and full regression remain root-controlled next steps.
